title: Bend Note
description: Defines a bend note that is automatically created for a bend line in a sheet-metal/flat-pattern view. Supported for export and edit (bend notes are auto-created, not created through the API).

position.description: Text center position of the bend note, non-associative. Editable.

attachmentPoint.description: Associative attachment point of the bend note on the bend line (carries the view it belongs to). Editable; must lie on the bend line.

bendLineText.description: The full displayed bend note text, e.g. 'UP 90.0 deg R2.29' (read-only, derived from the model).

angle.description: Bend angle value in degrees (read-only), consistent with how angular dimensions export their measurement.

radius.description: Bend radius value in the drawing's display units (read-only).
